svg.desc: In both homozygous mouse lines all detected Snap25 RNA has the 5a form. With the cassette retained, protein averages 80.7% of line-matched wild type. With the cassette excised, protein averages 110.9%. Symbols distinguish lines and whiskers show published standard errors.
